summary_en: This Phase II study tests pembrolizumab given with lenvatinib in patients with solid tumors that have spread to the brain, including triple negative breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and other solid tumor types. Pembrolizumab is given by IV at 200 mg on day 1 every 3 weeks, and lenvatinib is taken by mouth at 20 mg once daily; the total duration is not stated. The main outcome measured is intracranial objective response rate, assessed by modified RECIST v1.1.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa pembrolizumab combinado con lenvatinib en pacientes con tumores sólidos que se han diseminado al cerebro, incluidos cáncer de mama triple negativo, cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y otros tipos de tumores sólidos. El pembrolizumab se administra por vía intravenosa a 200 mg el día 1 cada 3 semanas, y el lenvatinib se toma por vía oral a 20 mg una vez al día; la duración total no se indica. El resultado principal que se mide es la tasa de respuesta objetiva intracraneal, evaluada con RECIST v1.1 modificado.
who_for: Age 18 years or older with confirmed triple negative breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, or another solid tumor
Brain metastases, with or without active disease outside the brain
At least one measurable brain metastasis of 0.5 to 3 cm on MRI
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
not_for: Non-small cell lung cancer with certain oncogenic driver mutations or fusions (such as EGFR, ALK, or MET amplification)
Prior lenvatinib or other antiangiogenic tyrosine kinase inhibitor, alone or with a PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor
Leptomeningeal metastases or symptomatic spinal cord compression
